title: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon
symptom: kind or docker prints `Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock` or `error during connect` on Windows.
fix: Docker isn't running. On macOS/Windows open Docker Desktop and wait until it says Running. On Linux start the service.
code:
sudo systemctl start docker
docker ps

title: permission denied … docker.sock (Linux)
symptom: `docker ps` works with sudo but not without.
fix: Add yourself to the docker group, then log out and back in (or use newgrp for the current shell).

title: kind create cluster: node(s) already exist
symptom: `ERROR: failed to create cluster: node(s) already exist for a cluster with the name "klu"`
fix: A cluster with that name is still around from last time. Reuse it, or delete it and create again.
code:
kind get clusters
kind delete cluster --name klu
kind create cluster --config kind-3node.yaml

title: kubectl: connection refused / wrong cluster
symptom: `The connection to the server 127.0.0.1:xxxxx was refused` or commands show objects you don't recognise.
fix: kubectl is pointing at an old or deleted cluster. List contexts and switch to the kind one. If Docker restarted, the node containers may be stopped: start them.
code:
kubectl config get-contexts
kubectl config use-context kind-klu
docker start klu-control-plane klu-worker klu-worker2

title: Pod stuck in Pending
symptom: `kubectl get pods` shows Pending for a long time.
fix: The scheduler couldn't place it. Read the FailedScheduling event: usually not enough CPU/memory, a taint, or a nodeSelector that matches no node.
code:
kubectl describe pod <pod-name>
kubectl get events --field-selector reason=FailedScheduling

title: ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull
symptom: Pod never starts; status says ImagePullBackOff.
fix: The image name or tag is wrong, or there is no internet. Check the Events section. For local images, load them into kind first.
code:
kubectl describe pod <pod-name>
kind load docker-image my-image:dev --name klu

title: CrashLoopBackOff
symptom: Pod starts, dies, restarts again and again.
fix: The app inside is exiting. Look at the logs of the last crashed run.

title: port-forward: address already in use
symptom: `unable to listen on port 8080` when port-forwarding.
fix: Something else (often an old port-forward) is using the port. Pick another local port or stop the old process.

title: Node NotReady after laptop sleep or reboot
symptom: Nodes show NotReady or the API server doesn't answer after a restart.
fix: kind node containers don't always restart cleanly. Start them; if still broken, recreate the cluster (it only takes a minute).
code:
docker start $(docker ps -aq --filter label=io.x-k8s.kind.cluster=klu)
kubectl get nodes

title: Go: missing go.sum entry / cannot find package
symptom: `go run .` fails with missing go.sum entry for module providing package k8s.io/...
fix: Dependencies aren't downloaded or go.mod is out of date. Tidy the module. Keep client-go, api and apimachinery on the same version.

title: Controller can't find kubeconfig
symptom: `stat /home/you/.kube/config: no such file or directory` when starting the Lab 3 controller.
fix: kind writes ~/.kube/config when it creates a cluster. If you created it with a different user or KUBECONFIG, export it for the controller.

title: Select-String is not recognized (macOS/Linux)
symptom: Commands copied from a lab fail with `Select-String: command not found`.
fix: Labs 1 and 2 were recorded in Windows PowerShell. Replace PowerShell-only helpers with their bash equivalents: see the shell differences table on the Commands page.
code:
# PowerShell:  ... | Select-String web
# bash/zsh:    ... | grep web
